item: Replacement water pump matched to the on-site pump model
rationale: The water pump was identified as needing replacement by Day 5 and a workaround stayed in place for the whole mission. The brief's lesson is to identify the pump model from the previous crew's report and bring a replacement unit (§2.3: if it can be identified from the manufacturer's spec).
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 518-523, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also Part II §2.3 Water systems, line 283
